jobs.tierReason: review of sensitive-job routing: which lanes may receive sensitive code
jobs.prompt: Security review of routing. coordination/review/routing.diff changes which lanes the router sends jobs to. Rules that must hold: a sensitive job (sensitive true or unset) must never reach OpenRouter, OpenAI, Gemini or Lambda; OpenRouter may only get jobs with sensitive: false whose outputs are ALL bookkeeping files; Hermes may only get jobs whose type route names it; Opus on the Anthropic lane needs tier expensive. Check, with evidence from tools/router.mjs, tools/openrouter.mjs and the diff: (1) can any sensitive job reach OpenRouter through routeJob, the typeRoute path, or the claude fallback; (2) can isBookkeepingJob be fooled (path tricks such as ../, case, backslashes, a file named like a bookkeeping file in a code directory, an empty or non-array outputs); (3) does removing Hermes from CHEAP_ORDER leave any code path that still auto-routes to it; (4) does the failure counting change (totalFailures now sums over order) allow Claude fallback too early or never; (5) anything else that widens where a sensitive job can go. Finish with one JSON line: {"status":"complete","summary":"...","findings":[{"file":"...","line":0,"severity":"high|medium|low","issue":"...","fix":"..."}]}.
